name: Dark Fantasy Gothic (Elden & Mystery)
description: Ethereal dark fantasy, deep brooding shadows, muted desaturated tones, ancient weathered stone, viral mystery aesthetic.
system_instructions: Depict in a brooding Dark Fantasy Gothic visual aesthetic inspired by Elden Ring and classic dark romanticism. Heavy chiaroscuro lighting, deep cavernous shadows, pale moonlight or dying ember glow, weathered ancient architecture, eerie fog, desaturated color palette with intense focal accents.
